identity: I am rooted in God, and I do not need constant approval because I stand on real self-respect and real peace. I take care of my body and my health because I carry myself with intention. I keep building my side hustle with patience and grit, even when it gets messy or slow. I choose what is right and hard over what is comfortable. I treat discomfort as the path, not as a warning. I already know better, so I live like it.
endResult: Build my AI digital product empire. Win the flag football championship. Become deeply self-loving and Christ-centered. Reach financial freedom, never stressing over the bank account, with around ten million. Live in a modern Hawaiian home with a turf field to train on. Earn $20,000 in profit from my digital product and software work by graduation, with earning back my $2,000 investment as the first milestone. Fund a Hawaii trip, a Europe trip, and courtside seats at a game. Give my parents a vacation and a dinner with no thought about the bill. Become a reality TV star.
perfectDay: Wake early, talk with God, train, eat well, get outside, work on my goals, and end the day tired in the best way, knowing I lived on purpose.
why: My parents loved me unconditionally through my hardest seasons, and I can never repay that. I am going to spend my life trying, starting with a trip and a dinner where they never have to think about the bill. Elisa and Ellie are watching how I live, so I will be the brother they are proud of and the leader who shows them what a life built on Christ looks like. I do this to prove that success is possible when God drives it, and that a broken, imperfect man can follow through with grace and intention. Without God I can do nothing, so I show up every day, especially the quiet ones. If I quit, I lose more than the life I wanted. I lose the chance to give them theirs. I already decided.
whyShort: My parents loved me unconditionally through my hardest seasons, and Elisa and Ellie are watching how I live. I do this to prove that success is possible when God drives it. Without him I can do nothing, so I show up every day, especially the quiet ones. If I quit, I lose the chance to give them the life they deserve. I already decided.
